definitions.explanation: Describes something with considerable thickness or depth. The opposite of {薄|うす}い (thin). Used for books, walls, slices, etc. Different from {暑|あつ}い (hot weather) and {熱|あつ}い (hot to touch).

examples.english: This book is thick, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {厚|あつ}い⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいます→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚|あつ}くて、⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦やすい→やすい：18367_yasui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This paper is thick and easy to write on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚|あつ}い⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ます→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I wear a thick coat in winter.

examples.japanese: {厚|あつ}い⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{重|おも}くて→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{運|はこ}び→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I bought a thick dictionary, but it's heavy and hard to carry around.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {厚|あつ}く
- Noun form: {厚|あつ}さ (thickness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚|あつ}い{本|ほん}: a thick book
- {厚|あつ}い⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧: a thick coat
- {厚|あつ}く⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to slice thickly
- Figurative (warm, deep): ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{厚|あつ}い (deeply trusted), {厚|あつ}く{御礼|おれい}⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧ (formal: my heartfelt thanks)

WATCH OUT:
Three adjectives are read あつい:
- {厚|あつ}い: thick (a book, a wall)
- ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧: hot (weather, a room)
- ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧: hot to the touch (tea, a stove)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: thin — the opposite
- ⟦{分厚|ぶあつ}い→分厚い：10502_buatsui⟧: very thick, bulky — more emphatic
